prod_writes: One manifest-driven data set, FIX-1256, 23:48:45-23:48:47 UTC, from docs/audits/2026-09-30-fix1256-bill-proposal-collisions.json. It ran as scripts/fix1256-repair-bill-collisions.mjs --prod --apply, the --then of session:wait-for-gate:prod --expected-minutes 1 --census off (gate OK at 23:48:44Z). It held the FIX-950 claim, which wrote the interlock and 17 guarded holds and released them. Six atomic DO statements. Three case-b pairs (HR 4795 / 9816 / 9847): each UPDATEd 1 external_source_refs row onto the 08-04 holder, DELETEd 1 identical entity_tags row and 1 entity_search_index row of the stub, UPDATEd 1 enrichment_queue row onto the holder, UPDATEd the holder's proposals row (the copy set in the report), DELETEd the stub proposals row, and called refresh_primary_source_for_entities for the holder. Three case-a bills (S 221 / 2466 / 3690): INSERTed 1 bill_details row each. No migration, no MV op, no hand-fired pipeline. Every other prod contact was a read: db-query --prod, the script's --build-manifest and --dry-run (READ ONLY transactions), session:held, prod_op_gate, and gh. Six pushes to main before this report, each through the pre-push hook.
